name: Gaol-Queen Verathine

Traits.name: Another Bleeds For Her
Traits.text: When a creature within reach of one of Verathine's chains — one under her command or one Restrained by her — is struck by an attack, the blow lands on the bound creature instead of Verathine, and that creature takes the damage in her stead.
Traits.clause: Whenever a creature under Verathine's command or restrained by her chains is struck, Verathine can pull the chain taut a
Traits.expresses: watching from behind her wall of bodies
Traits.expressedQuote: When a creature within reach of one of Verathine's chains — one under her command or one Restrained by her — is struck by an attack, the blow lands on the bound creature instead of Verathine, and that creature takes the damage in her stead.

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Verathine, Verathine and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided Verathine doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: Verathine makes three attacks, using Sentence-Keys or Chain Flail in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Barked Command.

Actions.name: Sentence-Keys
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. 33 (6d8 + 6) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Chain Flail
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. 33 (6d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Barked Command
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 19, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: Verathine barks a command at one creature it can see; the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be forced to o
Actions.expresses: commanding shackled prisoners who fight in her stead

lore: A warden who sold a piece of herself to the iron of her own prison, Gaol-Queen Verathine can never leave it—so she drags others inside, hoping for one captive who will stay of their own will.

generation.userConcept: a gaol-queen whose prisoners fight for her while she watches from behind them
